Domestic violence is not only physical. It includes the exploitation of a power imbalance, unwanted attention or sexual acts, and threatening behaviour.

Nolan Lawyers is well-practised in domestic violence law in Sydney.

We know that you want to move on with your life and want the best family lawyer possible. That’s why you must find someone who makes you feel comfortable. We encourage you to meet with a few family lawyers in Sydney so that you can be confident that Nolan Lawyers is unlike any other.

What to Expect When Consulting a
Domestic Violence Lawyer

Domestic violence is a silent crime. It’s possible that if you are a victim of domestic violence, the people who are closest to you don’t know that it’s happening.

It’s also important to know that domestic violence doesn’t only happen between husband and wife. It can happen between partners, adult children, and parents and children.

Whether it’s happening to you or someone you care about, your lawyer should approach your domestic violence case with compassion and empathy.

Here’s what you can expect from the domestic violence legal process in Sydney:

  • You will need to provide evidence of domestic abuse. The courts are aware that there are different kinds of domestic violence, so your lawyer should guide you on what to present as evidence.
  • The abuser will also attend court, and his or her lawyer will question your evidence. This can be a traumatic experience.

The courts can issue specialised orders, known as Apprehended Violence Orders (AVOs).
